title: Молодой гений Александр  (The Young Genius Aleksandr)

segments.t: Nagiyev presents young, self-assured chef Aleksandr Sergeyevich to the stunned cooks, boasting about the newcomer's European career. Back at the hospital, Elena Pavlovna walks into the ward with flowers and gently teases Viktor Petrovich for feeling awkward in his hospital bed.
Но это не так, это не так.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'The Russian land still gives birth to geniuses.' In Russian, the idea of 'to give birth' flows naturally into 'genius' without extra filler words.
'Rarely, but it does.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'rarely' before landing on 'to give birth'.
'I have heard a great deal about you.' The '-l' ending on the verb meaning 'heard' places the action in the masculine past tense. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Nice to meet you.' The meaning hinges on 'pleasant' working together with 'to meet' in spoken Russian.
'I am not a cook.' Nastya brings out the contrast between 'I' and 'not' in a few short words.
'Can you not tell?' Chef Viktor raises the pitch on 'one can see' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Nastya answers right away.
'I am right here.' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'here' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'That I am young.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'what', while 'young' completes the thought.
Но это не так, это не так.
'But that is not true, not true at all.' In Russian, the idea of 'but' flows naturally into 'like this' without extra filler words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'And I built my career over there.' In Russian, the idea of 'both' flows naturally into 'career' without extra filler words.
'It is somehow...' The grammar packs 'already' and 'somehow' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Unusual talking with you like this.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'unusual' and finishing on 'to talk'. Nastya answers right away.
'I will put the flowers in water for you.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'you' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Но это не так, это не так.

That wraps up this scene as nagiyev introduces young culinary star Aleksandr Sergeyevich to the skeptical kitchen crew, while Elena Pavlovna brings flowers to a flustered Viktor Petrovich in the hospital. See you next time!
